info.title: tbd protocol
info.description: The edge: REST and server-sent events over the registered gRPC backends. Every body is JSON; every error is the `Problem` envelope.

get.summary:
Readiness: every required backend answers `SERVING` to a live health
check. The body lists every registered backend either way, so an optional
one that is down is visible without failing the probe.

503.description: A required backend is not serving

200.description: A stream of `tbd.arena.v1.WatchResponse` events, one JSON object per `data:`; a failure is an `error` event carrying `Problem`

200.description: A stream of `EventBody` events; a failure is an `error` event carrying `Problem`

Code.description:
The stable error vocabulary. The slug (`snake_case`) is what clients see in
`code`; the HTTP status follows the standard gRPC mapping, plus the two
HTTP-only codes for request bodies.

oneOf.description: `google.rpc.RetryInfo`: when to try again; also the `Retry-After` header.

Detail.description: A typed detail, translated from `google.rpc` error details.

payload.description: Opaque payload, passed through to the engine.

Evaluation.description: `POST /v1/evaluate` response. `stub` is forwarded from the engine untouched.

model_version.description: Model version that produced the score.

stub.description: True while the score is a placeholder, not a model output.

oneOf.description: Periodic liveness tick from the engine.

stub.description: True while the score is a placeholder.

Key.description:
The key claims, as `OpenAPI` sees them.

A mirror of `tbd_common::principal::Key`. The type itself lives in
`tbd-common`, which cannot derive `utoipa::ToSchema` without taking a
dependency on a documentation crate it has no other use for. Mirroring it
here keeps `docs/protocol/openapi.json` byte-identical across this
refactor -- a published contract must not shift because of an internal
move.

parent.description: The parent key, for a sub-key.

client_id.description: The OAuth client the call came through, if any.

email.description: E-mail address, when the token carries one (a person's ID token does).

oneOf.description: Key and parent key, when minted.

name.description: Display name, when the token carries one.

role.description: Role, when the consent step stamped one.

Problem.description: `{"code","error","details"}`: the REST body and the SSE `error` payload.

Readiness.description:
`GET /readyz`: every backend's live state; `ready` when every required one
is serving.

ServiceState.description: What a backend's health service last answered, as `/readyz` reports it.
